newsitem.title: POLAND: HACHETTE LIKELY TO BUY POLISH FIRM IN JAN.
newsitem.headline: HACHETTE LIKELY TO BUY POLISH FIRM IN JAN.

text.p: A consortium led by the French Hachette Distribution Services is likely to buy Poland's biggest news-stand chain Ruch SA in January, a deputy treasury minister said on Monday.
"There is a chance that the transaction...will be completed in early January," Wieslaw Kaczmarek told a news briefing.
Last week, the ministry said it had accepted a price offer to buy Ruch. The offer came from the Hachette consortium, which also groups several Polish companies.
Kaczmarek declined to disclose details of the deal.

Hachette still needs to negotiate a package of social benefits with trade unions before buying Ruch, which has a 65 percent share of Poland's press distribution market and owns 17,000 news-stands nationwide.
Ruch's net profit in 1995 was 16.2 million zlotys on sales of 2.7 billion zlotys.
